question: Who among the following received the International Gandhi Awards for Leprosy in the individual category on 6 February 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. NS Dharmashaktu.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The International Gandhi Awards for Leprosy was awarded to Dr N.S. Dharmashaktu and the Leprosy Mission Trust in New Delhi on 6 Feb 2020.
 
• The award was presented by **President Ram Nath Kovind.**
 
• The International Gandhi Awards for Leprosy commemorates the compassion that Mahatma Gandhi possessed and his services towards people with leprosy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• World Leprosy Day is celebrated on the last Sunday of January every year all over the world to increase knowledge about it and propagate the need and importance of eradicating the disease.
 
• It was observed on** 30 January** in the year of 2021.
 
• There is no fix date for World Leprosy Day.
 
• It is celebrated on last Sunday of January.
